summary: Iteration 2 backend tests for AgendaBella new features: reviews, portfolio, packages (fidelidade), city/state location fields, city filter + name search on /api/professionals, and mocked WhatsApp notifications persisted in db.notifications. 18/18 pytest cases passed against the public URL.
passed: POST /api/auth/register stores city and state (verified via GET /api/auth/me)
PATCH /api/professionals/me updates city, state, business_name, address
GET /api/professionals returns avg_rating and reviews_count on every item
POST /api/reviews on confirmed booking returns 200 with correct rating/comment
POST /api/reviews second attempt on same booking returns 400
GET /api/professionals/{id} includes reviews[] + packages[] + rating summary
POST /api/portfolio adds image; GET /api/portfolio/professional/{pid} lists it; DELETE /api/portfolio/{id} removes it
POST /api/packages/checkout returns Stripe checkout_url + session_id for cliente
db.notifications collection: mocked_sent doc reachable via GET /api/notifications/mine (auth required, 401 when missing)
critical_code_review_comments: notify_whatsapp WhatsApp confirmation is best-effort inside /payments/status; if client or pro doc is missing it will 500 (no try/except around notify_whatsapp calls). Consider wrapping in try/except.

GET /api/notifications/mine filters by meta.user_id — ensure all notify_whatsapp callers set meta.user_id (currently confirmation + pro_new do). If future callers forget, notifications will be invisible.
server.py is ~825 lines, single-file; recommend splitting into routers (auth/professionals/bookings/payments/reviews/portfolio/packages/notifications) for maintainability.
PackageIn requires sessions_count > 1; consider >=1 for single-session promo packs.

notify_whatsapp is triggered inside payment_status polling; if the endpoint is called multiple times after payment, duplicate notifications may be inserted. Guard with a check on booking.notified flag or payment_transactions.notified.
action_items: Optional hardening: wrap notify_whatsapp calls in try/except; add idempotency guard to avoid duplicate WhatsApp mocks on repeated /payments/status polling.
test_credentials: Admin: cassimiro77@gmail.com / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test users created dynamically per run with TEST prefix.
seed_data_creation: Test users, service, availability, booking, review, portfolio item, package created; ephemeral users retained in db (unique emails).

WhatsApp notification trigger inside /payments/status was validated by inserting a doc directly and reading via /api/notifications/mine (since we can't force Stripe to paid without real card flow). Full end-to-end WhatsApp trigger via Stripe payment flip should be validated once frontend/E2E test runs. Iteration 1 tests still hold (24/24).
